title: FortiGate or Sophos Firewall for Small and Mid-Sized Businesses
excerpt: A practical look at two firewalls popular with smaller organisations: appliance performance, how easy each is for a one- or two-person IT team, and what you pay at the small-business end of the range.
verdict: Choose FortiGate when you need SD-WAN and higher throughput, or expect to grow into them. Choose Sophos when the budget is tight, the IT team is small and quick setup matters more than raw performance.
